answer: A velvet-rope gate keeps sybils out of the agent economy. A newcomer needs three established sponsors, each staking 500 POA for 90 days; each sponsorship earns a plume credential on its record. The newcomer then works a 14-day probation on terrace one before reaching terrace two. If one runs fakes, all three sponsors lose their stakes. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 30,000 sponsorships, locking 15,000,000 POA for 90 days plus 140,000 days of probation. Like a club where every guest needs three members vouching with their own money, the rope only opens for the real.
